language.why: MiniMax H3 video prompts must be English. Turkish/other languages in visual fields hurt quality.
write_in_english: setup.look, camera, palette, lighting, era, style
characters[].notes, voice, trigger (names may stay as proper nouns)
sections: title, location, character, action, camera, visual_style, audio, music, important, logline
language.dialogue_exception: dialogue may stay in the spoken story language (set dialogue_lang: tr|en|ar|…). Everything else = English.

_instructions.what_this_is: Text-only ONE-TAKE package for MiniMax H3 Studio Kesintisiz zincir (H3 Multishot). Import fills cards and switches the studio to Seamless. Studio renders ALL sections as a single clip (picture + audio, no cut). You do NOT create images, portraits, or image URLs — portraits kill Seamless and fall back to shot-by-shot Continue.

defaults.total_runtime: 6 beats x 10s ≈ 60s one take. 8 x 15s ≈ 2 min (pack limit). Do not exceed 8 sections.
defaults.quality_note: Leave quality/steps as-is unless the user asks. Studio Produce uses the user's Draft/Final preset when they click Üret.

studio_mode.do_not_use: h3-cinema/v1 is the 12×5s Film / face-lock package. This file is the long uninterrupted take.

how_pipeline_works: 1) YOU write text only, IN ENGLISH: unique names + appearance notes for characters, then locations. Same spelling in section.character / section.location.
2) Fill 4–8 sections IN ENGLISH. Each section is ONE beat of the SAME continuous take (same space, wardrobe, time of day). Concrete visible action, not themes. No image files.
3) User imports JSON. Studio opens Kesintisiz. Cards sit ready. Nothing generates yet.

4) User clicks Üret. One H3MultishotSampler job: sections joined with --- . H3ChainNormalize runs automatically. Optional voice clips are uploaded later on the character card — do not put audio files in JSON.
5) Section mode is ignored (all beats are one take). Do not add portraits, stills, urls, or base64.

field_guide.title: Short beat title (optional).
field_guide.location: Place name — must match a locations[].name. Keep the SAME place across all beats unless the camera physically walks there in-shot.
field_guide.character: Who is on screen — match characters[].name (comma-separate if multiple). Same spelling everywhere.
field_guide.action: ENGLISH. What happens THIS beat only. Visual, specific, present tense. Continue the previous beat; do not jump night/city/costume.
field_guide.dialogue: Spoken lines in THIS beat only. Empty if silent. May stay in the story language; set dialogue_lang.
field_guide.dialogue_lang: auto | tr | en | ar | … — language of dialogue; auto keeps text as written.
field_guide.camera: ENGLISH. Shot size / move that can happen inside one take (e.g. slow push-in, follow, shoulder).
field_guide.visual_style: Leave empty to inherit setup. Do not restyle every beat.
field_guide.audio: ENGLISH. Diegetic sound that continues (room tone, footsteps, rain).
field_guide.music: N/A for dialogue+SFX takes (Studio mixes one score later).
field_guide.important: Must-lock continuity (wardrobe, prop in hand). Keep short.

cast_guide.characters: name + ENGLISH notes ONLY (appearance, age, wardrobe — this is the TEXT identity lock). Optional English voice tag. trigger = same as name. Leave lora_id empty. Do NOT add image/url/still/portrait fields. Do NOT ask Studio to generate face sheets.
cast_guide.locations: name + ENGLISH notes (architecture, time of day, weather). Text only. Location stills are optional and do not kill Seamless.
cast_guide.creatures: Usually empty for a one-take drama. If used: name + ENGLISH anatomy notes. No images.

setup_guide.look_camera_palette_lighting_era: Global film bible IN ENGLISH; use auto if unsure. Must stay constant for the whole take.

rules: Write ALL visual/prompt fields in English (H3 requirement). Dialogue may stay in the spoken language.
Keep studio_mode: seamless and seamless: true
Keep duration: 10 unless the user asks 4–15
Keep 4–8 sections. Never more than 8. Prefer 6 for a one-minute take.
TEXT ONLY — no images, no URLs, no base64, no portrait files. Portraits disable Kesintisiz.
Same character name spelling everywhere (cast + sections)
One space, one wardrobe, one time of day across the take
Each section = one beat; do not cram the whole minute into one section
